title: dnd-5e-2024 shared definitions (docs/rulesets.md#shared-definitions)
description: Enums here mirror tables.json; tests/rulesets/dnd-5e-2024/schemas.test.ts keeps them in step.

Ability.description: An ability, by its three-letter key.

Skill.description: A skill, by its SRD name in kebab-case.

Dice.description: Dice with no modifier, such as "2d6". Modifiers come from an ability and a bonus.

Damage.description: One damage roll. In a list, the first is the primary damage and the rest render as "plus" riders.

dice.description: The damage dice. A damage entry has dice or a flat amount.

amount.description: Flat damage printed without dice, such as "1 Piercing damage".

bonus.description: A flat addition to the modifier: a deliberate deviation, listed as a warning.

type.description: The damage type. A damage entry has a type or a note.

condition.description: When a rider applies, printed after it: "if the attack roll had Advantage". Only on a rider, never the first damage.

note.description: Printed after "damage" in place of a type, for damage whose type isn't fixed: "of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait".

Proficiency.description: Proficient adds the proficiency bonus; expertise adds twice it.

Adjust.description: A deliberate deviation from a derived value, listed as a warning for the reviewer.

Ref.description: A link to a library entry. It renders the target's current name, linked to its page.

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the target's name, such as "level 5 version".

ConditionRef.description: A link to a condition, an SRD primitive or a custom extension (docs/rulesets.md#rules-data). A typed ref: it allows only condition keys. A `note` prints in parentheses after the name: "Charmed (with Mind Blank)".

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the name.

EquipmentRef.description: A link to equipment: an SRD primitive, a group, or a custom extension (docs/rulesets.md#equipment). A typed ref: it allows only equipment keys.

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the name.

FeatRef.description: A link to a feat (docs/rulesets.md#feats). A typed ref: it allows only feat keys. A `note` prints in parentheses after the name, for the choice the feat is taken with: "Magic Initiate (Cleric)".

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the name.

SpeciesTraitRef.description: A link to a species trait, a component of a species (docs/content-model.md#components). A typed ref: it allows only species-trait keys.

StartingEquipment.description: A class's or background's starting equipment (docs/rulesets.md#starting-equipment): two or more options, lettered A, B, C by the template.

items.description: One option: items, coins, or both.
A ref to equipment or an item, or Text for anything else ("20 Arrows", a variant).

ref.description: The target, as equipment/<id> or item/<id>.

count.description: How many, 2 or more, printed first with an "s" added: "2 Daggers".

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the name: "Parchment (10 sheets)".

gp.description: Coins, in GP, printed last: "8 GP".

WeaponPropertyRef.description: A link to a weapon property on the Weapons page; a note prints in parentheses after it: "Two-Handed (unless mounted)".

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the name.

MasteryPropertyRef.description: A link to a mastery property on the Weapons page.

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the name.

CountedRefOrText.description: A RefOrText whose ref may add a `count` of 2 or more, printed after the name with an "s" added: "Javelins (6)" (creature gear, docs/rulesets.md#creatures).

RefOrText.description: A ref to a library entry, or a plain string for SRD content not in the library.

Text.description: Rules text in the markdown subset, with tokens where the ruleset allows them.

Line.description: A stat block line, written as printed.

StatBlockItem.description: A named trait or action of an embedded stat block.

StatBlock.description: A stat block printed inside a spell or magic item (docs/rulesets.md#embedded-stat-blocks, docs/rulesets.md#embedded-stat-blocks). Authored as printed: only the ability modifiers and saves are derived.

typeLine.description: Size, type, and alignment, such as "Large Dragon, Neutral".

abilities.description: Ability scores. The modifiers and saves are derived.
